_about: Partial seed for the Flemington meeting, Sat 20 June 2026. Contains the meeting, all 9 races (official names/times/distances), and the KEY runners per race with midweek indicative prices, short form summaries, and a tipster-consensus prediction label. It is NOT the full field. Complete runner lists, barriers, weights, jockeys and live odds should come from the live OddsSource (Betfair). Prices are midweek quotes and move constantly — not final. Form summaries are paraphrased notes, not structured per-run history.

meeting.going: Soft 7 (midweek; rain about, may ease toward Heavy)
meeting.source: manual-seed compiled 2026-06-19 from public previews (see provenance)

runners.name: Star Of Macedon
runners.form_summary: Up to 1420m after two runs at 1200m; chased on at Caulfield behind Obambulate; a bigger, wetter track suits.

prediction.rationale: Top pick of both Welsh (Betsy) and Just Horse Racing.

runners.name: Fontein Jewel
runners.form_summary: Strong closing effort in the Elvstroem Classic; won on heavy ground at Pakenham — handles the wet.

prediction.rationale: Welsh each-way pick on wet form.

runners.name: Running Rich
runners.form_summary: Likely leader; tried hard when third in the Elvstroem Classic; exotics chance.

runners.name: South Yarra Miss
runners.form_summary: Lightly raced filly fresh at 1420m; three jump-outs under the belt; big-price watch.

prediction.rationale: Interesting fresh runner at long odds.

runners.name: Decalogue
runners.form_summary: Competitive in Group 2 Tulloch grade earlier this prep; dominant last start; well treated with the claim.

prediction.rationale: Welsh's 'horse to beat'; Maher stable in red-hot form.

runners.name: Our Chief
runners.form_summary: Ran third behind Dirnaseer/Kaleo here recently; peaking and up to 2000m.

runners.name: Arabian Prince
runners.form_summary: Forgive a wide, keen run on the bog here last time; class can carry him if there's petrol left.

runners.name: Salt Spray
runners.form_summary: Held up at Randwick last start; should get room to wind up and motor late.

races.name: Country Racing It's Got It All Trophy

runners.name: The Western Front
runners.trainer: Lindsay Park (B, W & J D Hayes)
runners.form_summary: Drops back to 2500m after a Sandown Cup (3200m) win; only needs to hold form.

runners.name: Bold Soul
runners.form_summary: Peaking third-up; ran this very race last year; kept hitting traffic last start.

runners.name: Virtuous Circle
runners.form_summary: Fourth-up, drops weight; strong late behind Ghetto Supastar; 2500m looks ideal.

races.name: Rod Johnson Handicap
races.course_note: Down the Flemington straight ('straight six') — barrier position matters little.

runners.name: Choir Point
runners.form_summary: Dominant Caulfield win with a sharp turn of foot; straight-track suited; handles heavy ground.

runners.name: Poker
runners.form_summary: Resumes; debut winner at Bendigo (that form has produced multiple winners); strong jump-outs.

runners.name: Prestar
runners.form_summary: Both career wins on Heavy ground — ideal today; brilliant fresh effort, drops weight.

runners.name: Recuperato
runners.form_summary: Trialled superbly; straight-track winner; awkward low draw.

runners.name: Ten Commandments
runners.form_summary: Wet-track specialist (no good on top of the ground); resumed with a 4.5L hard-held win; maps for a soft run.

prediction.rationale: Anchor of the day; double-tipped by Welsh + bets.com.au.

runners.name: Madero
runners.form_summary: French import, Australian debut; three nice pieces of work; touch of class but 1400m short of best.

prediction.rationale: JHR's pick to take on the favourite.

runners.name: Capper Thirtynine
runners.form_summary: Plain at Caulfield but the ride was awkward; 1400m at this level ideal if ridden patiently.

runners.name: Komachi
runners.form_summary: Found the track too wet at Morphettville Parks last start; trialled well; firmer-deck improver.

runners.name: First Chorus
runners.form_summary: In-form mare; sustained finish to win at Caulfield; loves the wet.

prediction.rationale: JHR top pick; wet-track angle on a soft day.

runners.name: Duchess Zou
runners.form_summary: Won her past two when she gets her toe in; dominant even allowing for suited conditions.

runners.name: It's A Knockout
runners.form_summary: Ran well fresh over this track and trip; had to alter course for clear air; maps for an in-form apprentice.

runners.name: Stylish
runners.form_summary: Better for the first-up run over this track/distance; upside to come.

races.name: Brian Beattie Handicap
races.course_note: Down the Flemington straight ('straight six'); markets still firming midweek.

runners.name: Losesomewinmore
runners.form_summary: Flemington straight-track specialist with a sharp turn of foot; gate 12 ideal; freshen-up aimed here.

runners.name: Bustling
runners.form_summary: Second in the Bel Esprit; tried hard on a testing track; peaking, a win looks coming.

prediction.rationale: JHR top pick (price not firm midweek).

runners.name: Recommendation
runners.form_summary: Game fourth in the Bel Esprit first-up; better for the run.

runners.name: Contemporary
runners.form_summary: Placed twice down this straight; handles any ground; weakest race of his prep.

runners.name: St George
runners.form_summary: Huge fresh over a mile last prep (Seymour Cup); trialled well; gets in well at the weights; only a bog track worries.

runners.name: Seafall
runners.form_summary: Held up but strong late in the Swan Hill Cup; hard fit and down in the weights.

prediction.rationale: JHR long shot (shortest of their trio).

runners.name: Beach Pad
runners.form_summary: Down to the 53kg minimum (7.5kg less than a recent win) — aggressive weight play; stamina an asset over a testing 1620m.

runners.name: Farhh Flung
runners.form_summary: Brave wide run when fourth in the Swan Hill Cup; in positive form.

runners.name: Detonator Jack
runners.form_summary: Resumed in the worst of the ground; best form is good enough.

runners.name: Paddypie
runners.form_summary: Unbeaten; fastest late sectionals at recent wins; steps up to town; inside draw the one query on a chopped-up rail late.

prediction.rationale: Second anchor; double-tipped by Welsh + bets.com.au.

runners.name: Kaleo
runners.form_summary: Super form; dead-heated with Dirnaseer here last start; hard fit.

runners.name: Obvious
runners.form_summary: Strong second behind Clevor Trever at Caulfield in worse ground; 1600m looks ideal.

prediction.rationale: Listed by both Welsh and JHR.

runners.name: Lucky Lucky Boom
runners.form_summary: Third-up and peaking; led and gave a sight last start; improver if he gets front-end control.

runners.name: Palladium
runners.form_summary: Ran better than his finish in the same Flemington race; settles closer from gate 3; big-price flier.
